claims.claim: 出现突发、不缓解的胸部疼痛或不适（可为压榨、烧灼或消化不良感），放射至左臂、右臂、颈、颌、腹或背，或伴冷汗、恶心、头晕、气短，应立即呼叫急救并接受院内处理。
claims.identifier: NHS chest pain page, last reviewed 2023-08-08
claims.supportQuote: Immediate action required: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 英国国家医疗服务体系对公众的急救指引；其"999"在中国对应"120"，症状清单与立即急救的动作适用于中国院外胸痛场景。
claims.uncertainty: 官方患者信息页，非针对运动诱发胸痛或中国人群的专设证据；引用时已将急救电话本地化为 120。

claims.claim: 胸部损伤或胸部锻炼后起病、吸气时加重、休息肌肉后缓解的胸痛，对应胸壁扭伤或劳损。
claims.identifier: NHS chest pain page, last reviewed 2023-08-08
claims.supportQuote: Starts after chest injury or chest exercise, may get worse when you breathe in, feels better when resting the muscle
claims.applicability: 描述与胸壁扭伤/劳损对应的症状模式，适用于久坐者恢复锻炼后胸痛的常见非心源性解释。
claims.uncertainty: 症状—病因对照表为患者自评提示，非诊断准确性研究；不构成对心源性病因的排除。

claims.claim: 纳入 172 项研究、42 项症状与体征的 meta 分析显示，没有任何病史或体格检查特征能单独安全排除或确诊心肌缺血。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: We included 172 studies providing data on the diagnostic value of 42 symptoms and signs. … none of these clinical findings showed in isolation a sufficient diagnostic accuracy for safely ruling in or ruling out myocardial ischemia in patients presenting with chest pain.
claims.applicability: 纳入急性与慢性胸痛、以客观缺血检查或临床终点为参照的诊断准确性研究；直接回答"单一体征能否排除心源性病因"。
claims.uncertainty: 研究间异质性高（多数指标 I2>80%）；以 QUADAS 评价质量为一般；未提供多特征联合的排除规则。

claims.claim: 劳力性疼痛诊断稳定型冠心病的阳性似然比为 2.13。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: exertional pain (pLR = 2.13) … for diagnosing stable CHD
claims.applicability: 将运动/劳力诱发作为心源性线索的定量依据；pLR 2.13 仅中等程度提高概率。
claims.uncertainty: 为稳定型冠心病亚组的汇总估计，非运动诱发胸痛人群的直接测量；区间估计见原文表 4，异质性高。

claims.claim: 触诊可复制的疼痛预测主要心脏事件的阳性似然比为 0.13。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: pain reproducible by palpation (pLR = 0.13) for predicting MCE
claims.applicability: 是"胸壁压痛可复制"这一常见排除依据的定量上限；0.13 为对主要心脏事件结局的 pLR。
claims.uncertainty: 针对主要心脏事件（MCE）结局而非 ACS 特异；仅为定性综合（原始研究 pLR 0.13–0.41），未给汇总区间。

claims.claim: 呼吸相关性疼痛排除心肌缺血的阳性似然比为 0.20–0.36。
claims.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: pain related to breathing might be helpful for ruling out myocardial ischemia, with pLR ranging from 0.20 to 0.36 in primary studies
claims.applicability: 为"与呼吸相关"这一常见非心源性线索的定量上限；提示有助于降低概率但幅度有限。
claims.uncertainty: 仅基于定性综合的原始研究范围（0.20–0.36），研究数少、未给汇总区间。

claims.claim: 高质量研究显示大学生运动员心脏性猝死发生率约 1:50 000 运动员年，高中运动员为 1:50 000 至 1:80 000 运动员年。
claims.sourceTitle: Incidence and Etiology of Sudden Cardiac Death: New Updates for Athletic Departments
claims.supportQuote: Studies of high quality and rigor consistently yield an incidence of 1:50,000 AYs in college athletes and between 1:50,000 and 1:80,000 AYs for high school athletes
claims.applicability: ≤35 岁运动人群心源性猝死发生率的上位估计；为运动后胸痛心源性病因先验概率的参照。
claims.uncertainty: 临床综述（证据水平 5 级），汇总了不同方法学的登记研究；为猝死而非胸痛的发生率，外推需谨慎。

claims.claim: 心脏性猝死高危亚组包括男性（1:37 790 运动员年）、非洲裔（1:21 491 运动员年）与篮球运动员（1:8 978 运动员年）。
claims.sourceTitle: Incidence and Etiology of Sudden Cardiac Death: New Updates for Athletic Departments
claims.supportQuote: men (1:37,790 AYs; incidence rate ratio, 3.2 compared with women), African American athletes (1:21,491 AYs; incidence rate ratio, 3.2 compared with Caucasian athletes), and basketball players (1:8978 AYs)
claims.applicability: 识别运动人群中心源性猝死相对高危的亚组，提示年龄、性别与项目分层的重要性。
claims.uncertainty: 美国大学生运动员数据，对中国人群与娱乐性久坐恢复锻炼者的直接适用性有限。

claims.claim: 英国专科心脏病理复核 720 例年轻猝死者中，最常见诊断为结构正常心脏（45%），其次为心肌病（29%）与冠状动脉起源异常（10%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Incidence and Etiology of Sudden Cardiac Death: New Updates for Athletic Departments
claims.supportQuote: 720 consecutive cases of young patients who suffered an SCD were referred from coroners and pathologists to a specialized cardiac pathologist. … The most common diagnosis yielded by the cardiac pathologist was a structurally normal heart (45%), followed by cardiomyopathy (29%), and coronary artery anomaly (10%)
claims.applicability: 提供年轻猝死者的病因分布，说明冠状动脉起源异常与心肌病在 <35 岁人群中的权重。
claims.uncertainty: 转诊至专科病理医师的英国连续病例（720 例），存在转诊偏倚；非中国人群。

claims.claim: 运动性晕厥、不明原因抽搐与早发猝死家族史是需要进一步检查或转诊的警示症状。
claims.sourceTitle: Incidence and Etiology of Sudden Cardiac Death: New Updates for Athletic Departments
claims.supportQuote: These signs and symptoms include those who present with exertional syncope, unexplained seizures, or a family history of early sudden death.
claims.applicability: 为运动诱发胸痛伴警示特征（运动性晕厥、猝死家族史）需急诊/专科评估提供依据。
claims.uncertainty: 运动前筛查语境下的综述表述，非针对胸痛分诊的前瞻性验证。

claims.claim: 多数运动员（60%–80%）在心脏骤停前无症状。
claims.sourceTitle: Incidence and Etiology of Sudden Cardiac Death: New Updates for Athletic Departments
claims.supportQuote: the majority of athletes (60%-80%) are asymptomatic prior to their arrest
claims.applicability: 说明以症状为基础的排除不可靠，支持"无症状不等于无风险"，进而限制"先恢复锻炼"处置次序。
claims.uncertainty: 综述引用的多源估计，用于论证症状盲区而非精确发生率。

claims.claim: 基层连续入组胸痛中胸壁综合征占 44.6%（300/672），胸壁疼痛占 51%，心血管疾病占 16%（其中冠心病 12.5%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest wall syndrome among primary care patients: a cohort study
claims.supportQuote: Among 24 620 consultations, we observed 672 cases of chest pain and 300 (44.6%) patients had a diagnosis of chest wall syndrome. … thoracic wall pain 51% (CWS 44.6%, traumatic 4%, divers 2.4%), cardiovascular diseases 16% (coronary artery diseases CAD 12.5%, non CAD 3.4%)
claims.applicability: 以 3 个月随访最终诊断为金标准的前瞻性队列，提供基层运动/非运动胸痛的病因构成基线。
claims.uncertainty: 欧洲私人诊所人群；随访以全科医生诊断为金标准，无系统缺血检查复核，可能低估冠心病。

claims.claim: 胸壁综合征队列中 19 例合并冠心病；触诊压痛点对该综合征不特异，约半数心绞痛患者存在压痛点、约半数胸壁压痛者患有冠心病。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest wall syndrome among primary care patients: a cohort study
claims.supportQuote: CWS coexisted with coronary disease in 19 … half of patients with angina pectoris have tender points … half patients with chest wall tenderness suffer from coronary heart disease
claims.applicability: 直接反驳"压痛可复制即可排除心源性"，并说明肌肉骨骼与冠心病共存。
claims.uncertainty: "约半数"为引用的既往文献（非本研究测量值）；本研究自身也发现压痛点多见于其他病因。

claims.claim: 随访中新诊断 3 例冠心病与 1 例心肌梗死，16 例初诊胸壁综合征被放弃（其中 3 例为冠心病）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest wall syndrome among primary care patients: a cohort study
claims.supportQuote: One patient was newly diagnosed with myocardial infarction and 3 with coronary heart disease … the initial diagnosis of CWS was abandoned in 16 patients for whom oesophagitis (7), anxiety or somatizing (4), coronary heart disease (3), lung cancer (1) and parietal metastases (1) were diagnosed.
claims.applicability: 说明"良性"诊断在随访中可能被修正，支撑"分诊起点而非终点"的定位。
claims.uncertainty: 单中心、随访以临床诊断为金标准；新发冠心病与初诊误诊之间的因果方向无法区分。

claims.claim: 基层胸痛占就诊 1.26%（281 例），最终诊断以肌肉骨骼最多（33.1%），威胁生命的病因占 8.4%。
claims.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
claims.supportQuote: In 281 (1.26%), chest pain was a reason for consulting the GP … Musculoskeletal pain was the most frequent working (26.1%) and final diagnoses (33.1%). Potentially life-threatening diseases as final diagnosis (such as myocardial infarction) accounted for 8.4% of all chest pain cases.
claims.applicability: 荷兰/比利时基层连续登记、30 天随访最终诊断，提供运动后胸痛可比的基层病因构成。
claims.uncertainty: 欧洲基层人群；无专家面板复核，可能漏检亚临床缺血；对中国与急诊人群外推受限。

claims.claim: 基层胸痛中两例（0.7%）初判为轻症、最终诊断为威胁生命的心血管疾病。
claims.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
claims.supportQuote: In two cases (0.7% of all chest pain patients), a mild working diagnosis was suspected, whereas the final diagnosis was a life-threatening cardiovascular
claims.applicability: 量化基层首诊对重症胸痛的漏判比例，直接支撑"不能仅凭病史体征排除"。
claims.uncertainty: 分子极小的比例估计，区间未报告；两例均为不典型表现（心房颤动合并缺血、肺炎合并心梗）。

claims.claim: 基层胸痛中不稳定缺血性心脏病的就诊前概率不超过 6.5%。
claims.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
claims.supportQuote: the pre-consulta- … tion probability of an unstable ischaemic cardiac disease in case of chest pain is no more than 6.5%
claims.applicability: 提供基层胸痛的先验概率上界，用于推导"安心体征"后的后验概率。
claims.uncertainty: 原文"no more than"表述为上界；为基层人群，非急诊人群（后者冠心病比例更高）。

claims.claim: 三组独立来源一致显示：非心源性（尤其肌肉骨骼）胸痛占多数，心源性病因以不可忽略的低频存在，且无法仅凭病史体征安全排除。
claims.applicability: 三条证据线分别来自诊断准确性汇总、基层胸壁综合征队列与基层登记，方向一致且非同一数据重复，支撑"分诊起点而非排除终点"的总体判断。
claims.uncertainty: 三来源均为欧洲人群、以非急诊场景为主；对急诊入口与中国院外自我处置场景的迁移存在间接性，按 GRADE 为低至中确定性。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Does the patient with chest pain have a coronary heart disease? Diagnostic value of single symptoms and signs – a meta-analysis
supportingSources.supportQuote: none of these clinical findings showed in isolation a sufficient diagnostic accuracy for safely ruling in or ruling out myocardial ischemia in patients presenting with chest pain.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Chest wall syndrome among primary care patients: a cohort study
supportingSources.supportQuote: thoracic wall pain 51% (CWS 44.6%, traumatic 4%, divers 2.4%), cardiovascular diseases 16% (coronary artery diseases CAD 12.5%, non CAD 3.4%), psychogenic pain 11%, respiratory diseases 10%, gastrointestinal disorders 8%, and no diagnosis 4%

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Frequency of chest pain in primary care, diagnostic tests performed and final diagnoses
supportingSources.supportQuote: Musculoskeletal pain was the most frequent working (26.1%) and final diagnoses (33.1%). Potentially life-threatening diseases as final diagnosis (such as myocardial infarction) accounted for 8.4% of all chest pain cases.

claims.claim: 以基层不稳定缺血性心脏病先验概率上界 6.5% 与触诊可复制疼痛的阳性似然比 0.13 计算，即便出现该体征，后验概率仍约 0.9%，不足以在无心电图与心肌肌钙蛋白时完成排除。
claims.assumptions: pLR 0.13 为针对主要心脏事件（MCE）结局的定性综合值，假定其可迁移至基层胸痛人群且与先验概率无关；先验取基层不稳定缺血上界 6.5%。
claims.sensitivity: 若以主要心脏事件先验区间上界 34.1% 代入，后验概率升至约 6.3%；结论方向不变，即"安心体征"不能将心源性概率降至可忽略。
claims.applicability: 定量回答"胸壁压痛可复制能否在无心电图与肌钙蛋白时完成排除"：不能。
claims.uncertainty: 0.13 为 MCE 结局的 pLR 且区间未报告，非 ACS 特异；先验概率取基层上界，急诊人群先验更高则后验更高。
